name: B10-0167/2026 (PPE) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia for tricking and forcing foreign nationals, especially Africans, into fighting its war in Ukraine. It says recruiters target people from poor areas with false promises of jobs, money and citizenship. It calls for everyone recruited against their will to be sent home immediately. It asks the countries these people come from, and European Union member states, to help bring them back and to investigate those responsible. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law; the Parliament formally states its position and demands repatriation.
- **Who it affects:** Recruited foreign nationals, mainly Africans, and Russia's recruitment networks.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the European Union's foreign policy chief, member states and Ukraine; no action is binding.
